handback.t:
H15 (R7-A) COMPLETE — the rare catastrophic HNSW build is ROOT-CAUSED, with a one-line fix validated and a no-crate-change workaround characterised. All synthetic-until-validated. Nothing in the repo Cargo.toml / src / ~/.cargo touched; all work is a standalone cargo project vendor_g17/harness2 against a second vendored copy vendor_g17/hnsw_rs_exp; vendor_g17/hnsw_rs_patched left exactly as the director set it.

ROOT CAUSE (distinct from the g17 reverse-edge bug): in hnsw.rs `search_layer`, the early-return `if points_by_layer[layer].is_empty()` is wrong for layer 0. points_by_layer[l] lists only points whose TOP level is l, but layer 0 conceptually holds every point. When the FIRST TWO inserted points both draw level>=1, layer 0's explicit list is still empty while point #2 descends, so point #2 gets no layer-0 neighbour and gives the entry no layer-0 reverse edge. Two layer-0 islands seed and never merge → one whole weak component is unreachable from the entry point → 8-47% of items silently unfindable (recall ~.67). Orthogonal to the g17 `l_n` line (reproduces identically on a reverse-edge-UNpatched twin, hnsw_rs_exp_unp).

REPRODUCIBILITY: patched hnsw_rs_exp's LayerGenerator with thread-local, default-off hooks set_level_seed() (replay OS-random builds) and set_forced_levels() (force first points' levels — the causal knob), plus a FIX_MODE AtomicU8. Default path is byte-identical graph to the stock crate on 1472/1472 non-flag builds, so the hooks don't perturb normal behaviour.

RATE = exactly 1/M^2, independent of N, dim, ef_construction, data (h15_grid, 3000 builds/cell): M=8 → 1.57% (CI 1.18-2.08, expect 1.56%), M=16 → 0.30-0.40%, M=32 → 0.10% (expect 0.098%). Pooled pure-iid M16 = 55/18000 = 0.306% (0.235-0.397%), consistent with H1's 0.55% [0.33-0.92]. Predicate "first-two-both-upper" == "layer-0 weak components >1" == "catastrophic" in every cell. Causally proven (h15_force): forced prefix [1,1] → 20/20 catastrophic; [1,0]/[0,1]/[0,0] → 0; FIX_MODE 1 on [1,1] → 0.

DUPLICATES are a red herring for this mode: dup5 shows 43% "catastrophic" by strict-id self-miss, but the graph stays connected (comps baseline) — a point's duplicate ties at distance 0 and wins top-1; it IS findable at distance 0. HnswIndex::audit already tolerates distance<=1e-6. Use connectivity / distance-tolerant audit, not strict-id self-miss, as the health metric.

FIX (one line, additive to the g17 patch), in results/h15_proposed_patch.md + results/h15_hnsw_layer0.diff:
  -  if self.layer_indexed_points.points_by_layer.read()[layer as usize].is_empty() {
  +  if layer != 0 && self.layer_indexed_points.points_by_layer.read()[layer as usize].is_empty() {
Validated (h15_cmp = g17 patch + this guard): all 10 naturally-found rare seeds lose 242-653/2000 unpatched and 0 with the fix; h15_wk fix1 arm 28/5000 flagged builds → 0 failures (none-arm 28/28 fail); graph FNV-hash byte-identical fix-off vs fix-on on 1472/1472 non-flag builds (differs only on the ~0.4% flagged); recall@10 / build-ms / us-query unchanged (n5000 d32 .9849/.9996/1.0000 vs .9846/.9996/1.0000; n2000 d384 identical across fixes). FIX_MODE 2 also 0-failure but changes the graph on a few non-catastrophic builds, so the minimal `layer != 0` guard is preferred. R7-A may NOT edit hnsw_rs_patched, so this is a proposal for the director to apply.

NO-CRATE-CHANGE WORKAROUND cost/benefit (h15_wk, 5000 builds/arm): modify_level_scale(0.2) → 0 flagged builds, 0 failures, ~no cost (removes BOTH HNSW modes, as g17 found; prints a library warning). audit_and_repair (existing src/memory.rs path) → 0 failures at s=100; a single rebuild with fresh levels repairs with prob ~1-1/M^2, so only ~0.6% of builds ever need one extra build. DETECTOR: an exact layer-0 weak-component count is a PERFECT, cheap detector (comps>1 iff catastrophic, 0 false/0 miss over 18k+ builds, ~0.5-11ms) — strictly better than sampled self-query; the sampled audit is weaker on clustered data (needs s=500 for 100% at d128) and must keep the distance<=1e-6 tolerance.

RECOMMENDATION: apply the one-line `layer != 0` guard to vendor_g17/hnsw_rs_patched/src/hnsw.rs (director's call). Zero cost, keeps the g17 fix, removes the mode entirely; audit_and_repair then becomes belt-and-braces.
